a.lede: Anthropic on Monday filed documents ahead of a blockbuster IPO that offers insight into the company’s financials, risk factors, and views on the future of AI.
a.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood

b.lede: Anthropic’s S-1 filing is hundreds of pages long—and it leaves out quite a few financial details. “Anthropic owes investors more information,” one analyst tells WIRED.
b.title: Why Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Is Missing So Many Key Figures
